verdict.rationale: Braintrust's first-party instrumentation docs say tracing records inputs, outputs, model parameters, latency, token usage and metadata for every request. Capture is documented through drop-in wrappers (wrap_openai), auto-instrumentation in the Go and Java SDKs, and OpenTelemetry, and traces are viewable in the Logs UI and CLI. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that token usage and latency are captured accurately.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: Instrumentation captures detailed traces from your AI application, recording inputs, outputs, model parameters, latency, token usage, and metadata for every request.
Braintrust provides `wrap_openai`, a drop-in wrapper around the OpenAI client that automatically logs all LLM calls to Braintrust.
attach the Braintrust Java Agent at JVM startup and supported clients are traced with no code changes
Inspect every agent trace and tool call, search across millions of logs, and track latency, cost, and quality in real time.
